blocks.text: Imagine a program that needs to decide whether to turn on the air conditioning, heating, or do nothing based on the current temperature. How does it make this decision efficiently?

blocks.markdown: In programming, conditionals allow us to execute certain blocks of code based on specific conditions. The most common conditional statements are `if`, `else-if`, and `else`. These statements help us make decisions in our programs by evaluating boolean expressions and executing code blocks accordingly.

blocks.title: Conditional Statements
blocks.text: Conditional statements are programming constructs that allow a program to execute different code paths based on the evaluation of boolean expressions.

blocks.markdown:
### If-Else-If Chains
An `if-else-if` chain is a series of conditional statements that allows us to check multiple conditions in sequence. The first condition that evaluates to true will have its corresponding block executed, and the rest will be skipped.

blocks.caption: General structure of an if-else-if chain

blocks.title: Temperature Control System
blocks.prompt: Write an `if-else-if` chain to decide whether to turn on the air conditioning, heating, or do nothing based on the temperature.

steps.text: Start by defining the temperature variable.
Check if the temperature is greater than 30 to turn on the air conditioning.
Check if the temperature is less than 15 to turn on the heating.
If neither condition is met, do nothing.

blocks.answer: This chain checks the temperature and decides the appropriate action based on the conditions.

blocks.markdown:
### Flattening Nested Conditionals
Nested conditionals can make code harder to read and maintain. Flattening these conditionals into a single `if-else-if` chain can improve clarity and efficiency.

blocks.title: Flatten Nested Conditionals
blocks.prompt: Convert the nested conditional structure into a flat `if-else-if` chain.
blocks.answer: The flattened version combines the conditions using logical operators, resulting in clearer and more concise code.

blocks.title: Avoid Redundant Tests
blocks.text: Ensure that each condition in an `if-else-if` chain is mutually exclusive to avoid redundant tests and improve efficiency.

points: Conditionals allow programs to execute different code paths based on boolean expressions.
`If-else-if` chains help in checking multiple conditions in sequence.
Flattening nested conditionals improves code readability and maintainability.
